newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas futures firmer again at end of busy wee.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas futures firmer again at end of busy wee.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were generally stronger on Friday afternoon as activity picked up after a slow start.

A total of 150 lots traded by the close, 120 of which were done in the afternoon session. This brought the total for the week to 1475 lots, an average of 295 lots a day, far higher than has been achieved in recent weeks.
December, January and February all traded higher. December posted the biggest gains, trading at 15.20 pence, up by 0.25 pence a therm from the previous settlement price.
January and February both traded for the last time at 18.075 pence a therm, up by 0.125 pence from a previous settlement in each case of 17.95 pence.
Front month August was bid at 9.60 pence and offered at 9.70 pence at the close. Bids and offers were posted in all 12 contract months.
